tables.name: assessment_years
tables.description: Assessment cycles available in INGRES. `assessment_year` is the portal label; `gwra_year` is the year of the published national report (label 2023-2024 == GWRA 2024, verified against PIB national totals).

columns.name: assessment_year
columns.description: Assessment cycle label, e.g. '2024-2025'

columns.name: gwra_year
columns.description: Year of the corresponding published Dynamic Ground Water Resource Assessment report

columns.name: is_complete
columns.description: 1 if the cycle has full national coverage and reconciles with published totals

columns.name: methodology
columns.description: Assessment methodology (GEC-2015 for all included cycles)

columns.name: caveat
columns.description: Comparability caveat to surface when comparing years
examples: All cycles use GEC-2015 methodology, but assessment-unit boundaries, district reorganisations, input data and parameter revisions differ between cycles; treat cross-year differences as historical change detection, not trend estimates.

tables.name: states
tables.description: States and Union Territories as named in INGRES (UPPER CASE, INGRES spellings e.g. TAMILNADU, LAKSHDWEEP).

columns.name: state_id
columns.description: INGRES location UUID of the state (stable across cycles)

columns.name: state_name
columns.description: State/UT name as spelled in INGRES

tables.name: districts
tables.description: Districts as named in INGRES (case varies by state).

columns.name: district_id
columns.description: Canonical cross-year district id (the district's INGRES UUID in the latest cycle it appears in)

columns.name: district_name
columns.description: District name as spelled in INGRES

columns.name: state_id
columns.description: INGRES location UUID of the state (stable across cycles)

tables.name: assessment_units

columns.description: Type of assessment unit (BLOCK, TALUK, MANDAL, FIRKA, ...)

tables.name: location_crosswalk
tables.description: Maps each year-specific INGRES UUID to the canonical cross-year id used in all other tables, with how the match was made (uuid / name / name_state / fuzzy / first_seen). Some states re-issue all UUIDs in a new cycle, so cross-year joins must use the canonical ids.

columns.name: level
columns.description: Location level: district or unit

columns.name: assessment_year
columns.description: Assessment cycle label, e.g. '2024-2025'

columns.name: ingres_uuid
columns.description: The year-specific INGRES location UUID as returned by the API

columns.name: canonical_id
columns.description: Canonical cross-year id (see unit_id / district_id)

columns.name: match_method
columns.description: uuid = same INGRES UUID; name = same state+district+normalised name; name_state = name unique in state; fuzzy = mutual best string match in same district; first_seen = no counterpart in a later cycle
